question: Which bīja syllables are invoked to protect the tongue and cheek?
premises: protection of the tongue is requested
protection of the cheek is requested
the syllables krīṃ and hūṃ are invoked
inference: krīṃ is invoked to protect the tongue and hūṃ to protect the cheek
plain_english: May krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ protect my tongue, and may hūṃ hūṃ protect my cheek.
